# Fix the draft: remove resume attachment and attach headshot

gmail_token = gmail_access['access_token']
fs_token = fs_access['access_token']
draft_id = 518
resume_attachment_id = 8483
headshot_path = '/home/norman/documents/work/professional_headshot.jpeg'

# 1) Remove the incorrect resume attachment
remove_res = apis.gmail.remove_attachment_from_draft(draft_id=draft_id, attachment_id=resume_attachment_id, access_token=gmail_token)
print('remove_res:', remove_res)

# 2) Attach the correct headshot
upload_res = apis.gmail.upload_attachments_to_draft(
    draft_id=draft_id,
    attachment_file_paths=[headshot_path],
    file_system_access_token=fs_token,
    access_token=gmail_token
)
print('upload_res:', upload_res)

# 3) Verify draft attachments are correct (verification read)
draft_after = apis.gmail.show_draft(draft_id=draft_id, access_token=gmail_token)
print('draft_after_attachments:', draft_after.get('attachments'))

# 4) Send the email from the draft
send_res = apis.gmail.send_email_from_draft(draft_id=draft_id, access_token=gmail_token, file_system_access_token=fs_token)
print('send_res:', send_res)
